how_to_apply: Use the application form for the post you are applying for. The notice contains a separate form for each of the five posts.

Address the form to The District Collector & Magistrate /Chairman, District Selection Committee, Mahabubabad District. Fill in the personal details, educational and professional details and the document checklist, then sign the declaration with the place and date.
Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the photo box.
Enclose copies of the certificates listed for your post, all attested by a Gazetted Officer.

Write on the cover: "Application for the post AYUSH Medical Officer/ Pharmacist/ Psychosocial Councellor/ Yoga Professional/ Multi Purpose Worker under NAM, Dept. of AYUSH". Strike off the post names that do not apply to you.

Hand in the application in person, or send it by Registered Post, to O/o. District Collector and Magistrate, Mahabubabad District, between 22 October 2026 and 29 October 2026, from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days.
The application must reach the office by 29 October 2026. Applications received after this date will be summarily rejected, and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.
important_instructions: Each candidate must use the form for the post they are eligible for. The name of the candidate and of the father, mother or spouse must be written as per the Aadhaar Card. By the declaration, giving false or incorrect information or hiding relevant facts may result in rejection of the candidature or cancellation of the engagement. For more information, the notice points candidates to the Mahabubabad District website: mahabubabad.telangana.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About Mahabubabad NAM
content_sections.text: This is a district-level engagement by the Government of Telangana, Mahabubabad District, for the AYUSH Public Health Programme under the National AYUSH Mission (NAM). The people engaged will work under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. Applications are addressed to the District Collector and Magistrate, who is the Chairman of the District Selection Committee, Mahabubabad District.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: Mahabubabad District will engage 10 persons across five posts. Reservation follows the applicable Telangana rules and the Presidential Order. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Age Limit
content_sections.text: Each post's application form also asks for the following: AYUSH Medical Officer: the qualification (BAMS / BUMS / BHMS / BNYS), the registration number issued by the Board of Indian Medicine (BIM), T.G., Secunderabad, and whether the internship has been completed. Pharmacist: the registration number issued by the Telangana Pharmacy Council. Psychosocial Counselor: the qualification (PG in MSW). Yoga Professional: the qualification (BNYS / Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Science (DNYS)). Multi Purpose Worker (MPW): the 7th Class qualification, with the name of the school and the year of passing. Every form except the MPW form has space for any additional or PG qualification and any relevant experience. These fields are marked "if any", and the notice does not make experience a requirement. For all five posts, candidates must be at least 18 years old and no older than 44 years, reckoned as on 1 July 2026. Every application form asks for the candidate's local status or district, with reference to the Telangana Public Employment (Organization of Local Cadres and Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order, 2018. For the MPW post, local status is taken from the Residential Certificate issued by the concerned authority. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy & Naturopathy system from a recognized institution, with the prescribed course of study and one-year compulsory internship. The prescribed one-year compulsory internship must be completed.
Must possess any of the qualifications D Pharmacy / B. Pharmacy / Pharma D Degree and should be registered with Telangana Pharmacy Council subject to the prescribed conditions.
Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) from a recognized University/Institution, as prescribed.
Degree in Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences or Diploma in Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences, subject to the prescribed conditions.
Must have passed VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All five posts are filled on an outsourcing basis under the AYUSH Public Health Programme of the National AYUSH Mission, under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. The Psychosocial Counselor post is on call and is paid per session.

rows.remuneration: Rs. 500 per session, at least 200 visits in a year (on call)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubabad NAM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Use the application form for the post you are applying for. The notice contains a separate form for each of the five posts. Address the form to The District Collector & Magistrate /Chairman, District Selection Committee, Mahabubabad District. Fill in the personal details, educational and professional details and the document checklist, then sign the declaration with the place and date. Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the photo box. Enclose copies of the certificates listed for your post, all attested by a Gazetted Officer. Write on the cover: "Application for the post AYUSH Medical Officer/ Pharmacist/ Psychosocial Councellor/ Yoga Professional/ Multi Purpose Worker under NAM, Dept. of AYUSH". Strike off the post names that do not apply to you. Hand in the application in person, or send it by Registered Post, to O/o. District Collector and Magistrate, Mahabubabad District, between 22 October 2026 and 29 October 2026, from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days. The application must reach the office by 29 October 2026. Applications received after this date will be summarily rejected, and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC / equivalent examination certificate with Bonafide Certificate Intermediate / 10+2 certificate, where applicable, with Bonafide Certificate Qualifying examination pass certificate with Bonafide Certificate Marks memos of all years of the qualifying examination Registration certificate of the concerned Board / Council, where applicable PG qualification certificate, where applicable Latest caste certificate, where applicable Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th Class and/or prescribed residency certificate, as applicable PwD / PH certificate, where applicable Ex-Service certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted Officer attested copies of all required certificates/documents Bonafide Certificate from Class 4th to 7th Latest caste certificate, where applicable Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th Class and/or prescribed residency certificate, as applicable PwD / PH certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted Officer attested copies of all required certificates/documents On every form, the sub-caste and any PwD / PH / VH status (with the certificate number and percentage) must be backed by a certificate. The forms for the first four posts also ask about ex-serviceman status. The MPW form does not.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Mahabubabad NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 4 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Pharmacist, 1 Psychosocial Counselor, 1 Yoga Professional and 3 Multi Purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Mahabubabad NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Mahabubabad District, by 29 October 2026 (up to 05:00 PM). Applications received after that date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The post needs a Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy & Naturopathy system from a recognized institution, with the prescribed course of study. The one-year compulsory internship must be completed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Mahabubabad NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 44 years old, reckoned as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Mahabubabad NAM posts?
faq.answer: AYUSH Medical Officer gets Rs. 40,000 per month and Yoga Professional gets Rs. 28,000 per month. Pharmacist and MPW get Rs. 15,000 per month each. Psychosocial Counselor gets Rs. 500 per session, with at least 200 visits in a year (on call).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Mahabubabad NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form for your post and attach copies of your certificates attested by a Gazetted Officer. Submit it in person or by Registered Post to O/o. District Collector and Magistrate, Mahabubabad District, between 22 October 2026 and 29 October 2026, from 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the application envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the post AYUSH Medical Officer/ Pharmacist/ Psychosocial Councellor/ Yoga Professional/ Multi Purpose Worker under NAM, Dept. of AYUSH" on the cover. Strike off the post names that do not apply to you.

faq.question: Q8. Are the Mahabubabad NAM posts on an outsourcing basis?
faq.answer: Yes. All five posts are filled on an outsourcing basis under the AYUSH Public Health Programme. The work is under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the qualification for the Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) post?
faq.answer: The candidate must have passed the VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

faq.question: Q10. Is registration needed for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must hold a D Pharmacy / B. Pharmacy / Pharma D Degree and should be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council, subject to the prescribed conditions.
